# QuestionAI

> > QuestionAI is an AI-powered homework helper and test preparation platform featuring ChatGPT integration, with specialized focus on SAT/PSAT exam preparation through its TestACE program.

The platform offers comprehensive standardized test preparation resources, particularly for the Digital SAT and PSAT, with expert guidance on scoring systems, test strategies, and college admissions. QuestionAI combines AI technology with educational content to help students improve their test performance and academic outcomes.

## Key Topics

- SAT exam preparation
- Digital SAT
- PSAT scoring and National Merit Scholarship
- TestACE program
- Rights-only scoring system
- ChatGPT-powered homework help
- College Board standardized tests
- SAT 2024 updates
- Test strategy and guessing techniques
- SAT Math preparation
- College admissions guidance
- 200-Point Score Improvement Guarantee
- AI-powered education tools
- Standardized testing resources

## App & Core Features

- [Question.AI: Homework Helper&Math Solver](https://www.questionai.com/download-app): App download page for AI-powered homework helper with ChatGPT integration

## SAT Exam Information & Strategy

- [Page 1 - SAT Exam Information - TestACE](https://www.questionai.com/blog-satexaminformation/1): SAT exam information hub with 200-Point Score Improvement Guarantee
- [Do You Lose Points for Wrong Answers on the SAT 2024?](https://www.questionai.com/blog-satexaminformation-bRbGBccXC4/lose-points-wrong-answers-sat-2024): Explains SAT 2024 rights-only scoring system and guessing strategy

## PSAT & Related Testing

- [How PSAT Scores are Calculated?](https://www.questionai.com/blog-satrelatedinformation-bwgQw9ZvfH/psat-scores-calculated): Guide to PSAT scoring methodology and National Merit consideration
